summary.text: Mike Andrade is a Democratic member of the Indiana House of Representatives who has represented District 12 since November 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a businessman and serves on the board of the Challenger Learning Center.

paragraphs.text: Andrade took office in the Indiana House on November 4, 2020, succeeding Mara Candelaria Reardon.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Andrade's campaign described him as representing Munster, Highland, Griffith, north Schererville and unincorporated St. John, and as a small business owner who is married with a son.

The same survey response says he serves on the board of directors of the Challenger Learning Center of Northwest Indiana, is a member of the National Hispanic Caucus of State Legislators, and is a commissioner on the Indiana Commission on Hispanic/Latino Affairs.
It lists unions and working families, minimum teacher pay and women's health care among his priorities, including his authorship of House Bill 1343 on minimum teacher salary.
